description: This routine is designed to balance and hydrate combination skin while protecting it from daily environmental stressors.

morning_steps.purpose: Remove any residual oils and impurities from the skin, preparing it for further treatments.
Refine pores and restore skin's pH balance after cleansing.
recommended_ingredients: Astringent with salicylic acid or witch hazel

morning_steps.purpose: Provide hydration without leaving a greasy residue. Combining water and oil-based products can help maintain the skin’s natural barrier.
recommended_ingredients: Lightweight gel moisturizer with hyaluronic acid

morning_steps.purpose: Protect the skin from harmful UV rays which can cause premature aging and hyperpigmentation.

night_steps.purpose: Remove makeup, dirt, and excess oil from the skin before bed to prevent clogged pores.
recommended_ingredients: Gentle cleansing balm or micellar water

night_steps.purpose: Remove dead skin cells and promote cell turnover. Be gentle on combination skin, especially in the T-zone.
recommended_ingredients: Chemical exfoliant with lactic or salicylic acid

night_steps.purpose: Lock in moisture overnight to support healthy skin turnover and repair.
recommended_ingredients: Rich night cream with ceramides and peptides

do: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to keep your skin hydrated from within.
Use gentle, non-comedogenic products to avoid clogging pores.
dont: Avoid harsh exfoliants and heavy oils that can cause irritation or excess oil production in combination skin.
Do not skip SPF even on cloudy days as UVA rays penetrate clouds and affect the skin.
common_mistakes: Over-exfoliating, which can lead to redness and increased sensitivity.
Using too many products at once, leading to potential irritation or clogged pores.

expected_results.2_weeks: Skin will appear more balanced and hydrated, with reduced oiliness in the T-zone.
expected_results.1_month: Fine lines may be less noticeable, skin texture should feel smoother, and pores appear smaller.
expected_results.3_months: Overall skin condition improves, with a more even tone and reduced occurrence of breakouts.

expert_tips: Always patch test new products to ensure you are not allergic or sensitive to any ingredients.
Adjust your routine according to seasonal changes in weather and environmental conditions.
